description: Use after a scan reports MACHINE_CHAIN_HEAVY (crawlers must read too many or too large files before the page). Returns a fix plan: the files a crawler reads before the page and the 404s that absent agent files return, then measured reductions (llms.txt to an index, a sitemap index, robots.txt comments and duplicate groups, minified JSON, short 404s) with the chain size after each step and the step at which the finding stops firing. Read-only; changes nothing on the site. Give domain (uses the latest scan on file) or a report id. For other findings use explain_finding.

domain.description: Uses the latest scan on file
